fundamentals.business_summary: HFCL Limited manufactures and sells telecom products in India and internationally. The company offers optical fiber cables, such as underground, aerial, microduct, FTTH, and micromodule cables; access solutions, including Wi-Fi access points, network switches, unlicensed band radios, IO canvas unified network management platform, and accessories; IP/MPLS routers; 5G product portfolio comprising access routers/cell site routers and pre-aggregation and aggregation routers; fiber optic cable and copper cable assemblies, high-density cabinets, fiber splice joint closures, ethernet cabling products, and active optical components; and defence solutions, including electro optics, electronic fuzes, ground surveillance radar, high-capacity radio relay, and software defined radios. It also provides network solutions for public telecommunications, defence and railway communications, and system integration services. The company was formerly known as Himachal Futuristic Communications Limited and changed its name to HFCL Limited in October 2019. HFCL Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.

fundamentals.business_summary: Punjab National Bank provides various banking and financial products and services in India and internationally. The company operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company offers personal banking products and services, including saving fund accounts, current accounts, fixed deposit, and capital gain account and gold monetization schemes; and housing, vehicle, education, personal, gold, and mortgage and other loans. It also provides various micro, small, and medium enterprises schemes and loans; banking products for government customers; agricultural schemes and loans; corporate banking products and services consist of loans against future lease rentals, working capital financing, and term loans; EXIM finance and cash management services, as well as gold card schemes for exporters; and international banking products and services. In addition, the company offers life and general insurance services; depository, mutual funds, merchant banking, and application supported by blocked amount services; and NRI banking and services. Further, the company provides mobile and internet banking, UPI, SMS banking, missed call, e-statement, ATM, passbook updating machine, and electronic cheque deposit machine services; and point of sale (PoS) is the payment acceptance solutions, NFC-enabled terminals facilitating quick payments, as well as debit and credit cards. Punjab National Bank was incorporated in 1894 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

The company was formerly known as UrbanClap Technologies India Limited and changed its name to Urban Company Limited in April 2025. It operates through the Chemicals, Fertilisers, and Realty segments. The company offers chemicals, including ammonia, methanol, dilute and concentrated nitric acid, carbon dioxide, iso-propyl alcohol, propane, and bulk and speciality chemicals; and fertilisers, such as nitro phosphate, mutriate of potash, diammonium phosphate ap, ammonium sulphate, mixtures, single super phosphate, sulphur, micronutrients, SSF, and bio fertilisers. In addition, the company provides petroleum; consultancy to mining companies; and value-added blasting services to mining and explosives industries. Further, it engages in the value-added real estate and agriculture produce businesses; storage and handling of technical ammonium nitrate; purchase and sale of commodities; gas trading; brand management; online sale of products; leasing of furniture and home improvement products; development of an e-commerce platform; and construction and operations of design centers, shopping malls, complexes, and retail outlets, as well as other allied activities. Deepak Fertilisers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Pune, India.
